hero.title: Eliminate. Prevent. *Protect.*
hero.lede: Three generations of the Jury family have protected homes and businesses across the CSRA. Pest control built around your home, termite protection, mosquito control and whole-home water filtration, from our office in North Augusta.

image.alt: A Jury technician in a blue uniform treating the shrubs along a home’s brick wall

items.title: Home pest control
items.text: Ants, roaches, spiders, silverfish and more: an inspection inside and out, quarterly visits, and free re-treatments if pests come back between them.

items.title: Commercial pest control
items.text: Plans built to your industry’s standards, with audit-ready reports and discreet off-hours treatments.

items.title: Termite protection
items.text: Inspections and clearance letters, liquid treatments and bait systems, pre-construction treatments and damage warranties.

items.title: Mosquito reduction
items.text: Monthly barrier sprays, standing-water fixes, and treatments before outdoor weddings and parties.

items.title: Bed bugs, fleas & rodents
items.text: Fast, thorough treatment for bed bugs and fleas, and rodent solutions with a satisfaction guarantee.

items.title: Crawl spaces & water
items.text: Vapor barriers and dehumidifiers, and Pure Way whole-home water filtration, installed and serviced by our team.

sections.title: Hard on pests, *easy on your family*

items.title: Inspection
items.text: A technician checks inside and around your home or building to find what’s getting in, and where.

items.title: A plan for your place
items.text: Treatments chosen for your pests and your property, designed to keep family, pets and employees safe.

items.title: Regular visits
items.text: Quarterly service and exterior barriers keep pests from coming back.

items.title: Free re-treatments
items.text: If pests return between scheduled visits, we come back at no charge.

sections.title: Three generations *of the Jury family*

image.alt: A Jury technician shaking hands with a homeowner at her front door

body: Jury Pest Services began with Charles Jury and his sons, Johnny and Paul, and grew out of Midway Pest Control into the team it is today. Third-generation leaders Justin and Cameron run the business now, keeping the same values: professional work, fair prices and long relationships with customers.
Our technicians are certified and keep training, and every plan is built around the pests that press on homes and businesses here in the CSRA.

items.text: Cameron always has a great smile, an upbeat attitude, and great service. We’ve had several other pest control services in the past, but Jury is the best!
Jury pest control has been servicing my home over thirty years and I have not had any complaints about them.
Cameron was very thorough with inspecting the crawlspace and explained everything he saw and did.

items.q: What if pests come back between visits?
items.a: We come back and re-treat at no charge.

items.q: Are your treatments safe for kids and pets?
items.a: Our integrated approach is designed to keep family, pets and employees safe, and our mosquito treatments include eco-conscious options that are safe for children and pets once dry.

items.q: Can you provide a termite letter for a home sale?
items.a: Yes. We do thorough structural termite inspections and clearance letters (WIR).
Yes: Augusta, Evans, Martinez, Grovetown, Hephzibah, Waynesboro, Thomson and nearby.
